title: Rank 1: Jack Frost with Mabufu
requirement: Jack Frost (Magician) with Mabufu
reward: Strength Social Link Rank 1, Unlocks Group Guillotine
walkthrough: Fuse Berith (Hierophant) with Silky (Priestess). Alternatively, level Jack Frost to level 12 to learn Mabufu naturally.

title: Rank 2: Shiisaa with Frei
requirement: Shiisaa (Chariot) with Frei
walkthrough: Fuse Jack-o'-Lantern (Magician) with Makami (Temperance). Makami knows Frei, inherit it during fusion.

title: Rank 3: Matador with Magaru
requirement: Matador (Death) with Magaru
reward: Strength Social Link Rank 3, Unlocks Lockdown
walkthrough: Fuse Nekomata (Magician) with Obariyon (Fool). Nekomata knows Magaru, inherit it.

title: Rank 4: Flauros with Tarukaja
requirement: Flauros (Devil) with Tarukaja
walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Berith + Andras + Eligor. Eligor has Tarukaja naturally, inherit it.

title: Rank 5: Ame-no-Uzume with Dodge Psy
requirement: Ame-no-Uzume (Lovers) with Dodge Psy
reward: Strength Social Link Rank 5, Unlocks Guillotine Booster
walkthrough: Fuse Kin-Ki (Chariot) with Sui-Ki (Chariot). Sui-Ki learns Dodge Psy at level 27, level him up and inherit the skill.

title: Rank 6: Neko Shogun with Dekaja
requirement: Neko Shogun (Star) with Dekaja
walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Kodama + Sudama + Anzu. First fuse Orobas (knows Dekaja) with Kodama to get Sudama with Dekaja. Then complete the fusion.

title: Rank 7: Lachesis with Tetraja
requirement: Lachesis (Fortune) with Tetraja
walkthrough: Fuse Koppu Tengu (who knows Tetraja) with Pixie to make Clotho with Tetraja. Then fuse Clotho with Regent or Stone of Scone to get Lachesis.

title: Rank 8: Hecatoncheires with Masukukaja
requirement: Hecatoncheires (Hanged Man) with Masukukaja
reward: Strength Social Link Rank 8, Unlocks Isolation
walkthrough: Fuse Lilim (Devil) with Anzu (Hierophant). Lilim learns Masukukaja at level 34, level her up first and inherit it.

title: Rank 9: Bugs with Samarearm
requirement: Bugs (Fool) with Samarearm
walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Pixie + Pisaca + Hariti. Hariti learns Samarearm at level 41. Level Hariti up first and inherit it.

title: Rank 10: Seth with High Counter
requirement: Seth (Tower) with High Counter
reward: Strength Social Link Rank 10, Unlocks Special Treatment & Zaou-Gongen
walkthrough: Advanced Guillotine fusion: Isis + Anubis + Thoth + Horus. You can obtain a High Counter Skill Card from request 'The Killer Who Cleans Up' on 10/14, or fuse Dakini (learns it at level 52) with Pale Rider to get Horus, inheriting High Counter.
